title: PawAI IEEE Access evaluation artifacts
description: Evaluation artifacts for P.-Y. Lu and W.-F. Tung, "A Multimodal Quadruped Robot with Hybrid Edge–Cloud Deployment and Deterministic LLM Skill Arbitration," IEEE Access (under review): measurement harness, sentence-bank text and reference transcripts, injected arbitration cases, analysis and plotting scripts, and per-experiment summary files. Code is released under the BSD 2-Clause License and data under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA). The evaluated robot software is PawAI commit 81e5018 (release ieee-access-2026).
